html: Well, the quest goes on.  I know it’s a frustrating wait, it certainly is for me, since we’ve had an agreement with the publisher on major contract terms since late August.  We got a little bit closer last week on getting the attorneys to agree on wording on TV and Movie rights so I’m hoping we get this thing signed before the end of October.  I hate having it complete and just sitting on the virtual shelf.  In the meantime, I’ll try to keep you up to date as I learn new details.
